fingerprint_normalization.normalization: Structural alpha-canonical expression: erase metadata and binder display names; preserve de Bruijn indices, universe levels, constants, binder kinds and expression shape. No definitional-equality or cross-version reuse claim.

hash_conventions.composite: SHA256 of json.dumps(sort_keys=True,separators=(comma,colon),ensure_ascii=True).encode(UTF-8), without trailing newline; pretty file bytes have separate artifact hashes.
hash_conventions.source: Exact immutable PDF byte SHA256. Expanded source selection and actual contract are separately bound inside policy-domain payload, so unchanged PDF alone never establishes unchanged source claim.
hash_conventions.type: Existing native-extracted alpha-canonical expression SHA256, used exactly as emitted; not a hash of printed Lean text or a claim of full definitional normalization.
hash_conventions.policy: Digest of exact semantic contract object, source version/locations/row locator, historical or current profile and gate-policy bindings, and separately recorded complete user interpretation. Excludes mutable gate epoch/tree/rebinding coordinates; exact original artifact blobs remain in source-selection evidence.
hash_conventions.producer: Digest of actual canonical module/declaration/kind/type/universe-parameter fingerprints. Proof bytes and the legacy forwarding path are not part of producer identity; both remain separately bound.
hash_conventions.proof: Existing native-extracted alpha-canonical proof expression SHA256; owner exact bytes and original proof retention checked independently.
